description: Implementation of MeetingReadPlatformService for accessing meeting data from the database, including methods to retrieve meetings by ID, entity, calendar type, and last meeting.

classes.name: MeetingDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation to map SQL result set to MeetingData objects.

methods.name: retrieveMeeting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific meeting by its ID, entity ID, and entity type ID.

methods.name: retrieveMeetingsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a list of meetings associated with a specific entity, with optional limit.

methods.name: retrieveMeetingsByEntityByCalendarType
methods.description: Retrieves meetings for an entity filtered by calendar types.

methods.name: retrieveLastMeeting
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent meeting for a given calendar instance.
